title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing you with powerful new capabilities to enhance your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Control in the Editor
summary: Our latest update empowers you to effortlessly manage and customize all your embedded files, giving you unprecedented control over their appearance and behavior directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track our latest updates, discover what's coming next, and see our long-term vision.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a seamlessly updated checkbox experience featuring larger, more interactive elements that are visually consistent and easier to drag, streamlining your task management.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: We've supercharged your team's ability to work together seamlessly, making every shared project smoother and more intuitive.

title: Seamless Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless collaboration as you effortlessly share ideas and discover relevant content from your network.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower our community with unparalleled control and direct involvement in shaping the project's exciting future.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko to a global audience by offering comprehensive support for multiple international languages.

title: Elevate Your Look: Introducing Beautiful New Themes & Refreshed Classics
summary: We're enhancing your visual experience with stunning new theme additions and significant improvements to our existing collection, offering a truly personalized look for your workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: We're transforming your Constellation view into a powerful, interactive knowledge map, allowing you to filter by tags, time, and shared items to discover new connections and streamline your workflows.

title: Discover & Organize with Powerful Search
summary: Elevate your search experience with robust new tools that enable precise knowledge discovery and allow you to save your tailored views as personalized Compendiums.

title: Richer Connected Notes
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to view and engage with your linked thoughts and content directly within your notes.

title: Noeko: Flexible Deployment and Empowering Plans
summary: Experience the next evolution of Noeko with new self-hosting capabilities and versatile plans, designed to give your team unprecedented control and tailored value.

title: Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience with smarter, more accurate greetings on your homepage that always reflect the correct time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Content Management
summary: Take control of your tags with new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly remove or manage associated items directly from any tag view.

title: Bring All Your Information Together
summary: Experience a richer knowledge base as you seamlessly integrate content from YouTube videos, websites, text files, and even pasted text, alongside your PDFs, for more comprehensive insights and discoveries.
